d: Nash and Joe search for a psychopath who telecasts videotapes of his crimes on the Internet; Joe considers suing a restaurant.
Nash and Joe scramble to find enough evidence to prove the innocence of a man on death row; a parent sues Joe, claiming his daughter is mistreating his son in preschool.
Nash and Joe share a jail cell while awaiting trial over the murder of three fellow police officers during a drug bust.
Nash's ex-wife arrives from Paris and informs him that a bureaucratic snafu fouled up their divorce 12 years earlier.
Nash and Caitlin pose as a married couple while investigating wife-swapping parties; Joe helps steal a corpse.
Wealthy businessmen play a bizarre war game that leads to deadly consequences; Evan's lover is the assistant district attorney's fiancée.
Nash's mysterious friend helps in the search for a murderous arsonist; Joe tries to throw a surprise party for Nash.
Nash and Joe attempt to prevent a zealous INS agent from deporting a baseball star who is in the country illegally.
Caitlin reveals details about her past to Nash; Joe battles a strict exercise and diet program; Cassidy and Nick team up for a tango competition.
Caitlin accidentally shoots Nash in the posterior; his pompous nemesis (Daniel Roebuck) replaces him.
While Nash pursues a gang of teenage carjackers, Joe goes undercover at a department store to catch a thief.
Nash must protect a young singer from obsessed fans intent on kidnapping her; Joe's attempt to buy his wife a car at a police auction backfires.
Nash's daughter faces death after a car crash; a sniper is loose in the city; Joe battles rats; guest Dee Wallace Stone.
An undercover police officer joins forces with Nash to put a choke hold on marauding bodybuilders who are pumped up on illegal steroids.
Nash and Joe try to find the governor of California after he slips out of sight, fearing the exposure of a possible sex scandal involving his mistress.
Nash and Joe search for a serial bomber; Cassidy must perform topless in her new play while her father is in the audience; Nick befriends a noisy band.
Nash and Joe search for a serial killer; Caitlin and Joe coach girls' soccer teams; Harvey reconciles with his estranged wife.
Nash and Joe must cure an amnesiac to rescue a man from the Russian mob; Joe undergoes fertility tests.
Nash must protect Caitlin after she is portrayed as a kinky sex addict on the Internet by a former cop who she helped send to jail for wife beating.
